issue_container.title: Find a different, useful reconstruction approach for G06/G13
issue_container.body:
Investigate a different software-backed approach to reconstruct G06/G13 from the existing RF archive; a previously blocked agent is not required.

Use all twenty original windows per case, retain missing and unsupported cases, and compare with unchanged v3 plus the fixed local likelihood comparator.

Exclude the candidate state/products from selection, calibration, initialization and fitting; no G12 state, target-orbit prior or historical fitted seed.

Preserve minimum five admitted receivers, the 10-degree mask, original floors and covariance, free biases, central+J2 dynamics and p=.01 final residual criterion.

Freeze fits and RF predictions before held-out RF and CODE scoring; retain ambiguity, failures and worsening results without post-score tuning.

The external contribution may be a transferable operation or partial technique, but it needs source-owned code evidence and native improvement to demonstrate value.
